description: Signs a transaction that can be submitted to the network later using eth_sendRawTransaction - not supported by Quicknode!

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The transaction response object which contains the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: from
sub_parameters.description: The address the transaction is sent from

sub_parameters.name: to
sub_parameters.description: (optional for contract creation) The address the transaction is directed to

sub_parameters.name: gas
sub_parameters.description: (default: 90000) The integer of the gas provided for the transaction execution

sub_parameters.name: gasPrice
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the gasPrice used for each paid gas, in wei

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction, in wei

sub_parameters.name: data
sub_parameters.description: The compiled code of a contract or the hash of the invoked method signature and encoded parameters

sub_parameters.name: nonce
sub_parameters.description: The integer of a nonce. This allows overwriting the own pending transactions that use the same nonce
